page.notes: Lower part of the page is cut off and continues in part 2. Marginal notes on the left edge are cut or unreadable and were not transcribed. Some words in the text are uncertain (e.g. "cxinde", "aspexitatis", "Herculis acta") and may be printing errors. Marginal notes are set in small type and partly cut off at the edges. The reading "Buce-phalen" and "ostendere" are as printed; "Gesleanos" may be misprinted for Gesleanos or similar. Some words in the notes, such as "Militibus fi-ne bellorum", are uncertain.
